sure.definition:
s. physically secure or dependable
s. (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence
s. infallible or unfailing
s. certain not to fail
sure.translation:
a. 确信, 必然的, 必定的
adv. 当然, 确实地, 无疑地

sure-footed.definition:
s not liable to stumble or fall
s not liable to error in judgment or action

sure-handed.definition: s proficient and confident in performance
sure-handed.translation: a. 手巧的；灵巧的, 熟练的；巧手制成的；精巧的

surefire.translation: a. 准不会有错的, 定能达到目的的

surefooted.definition: s. not liable to stumble or fall
surefooted.translation: a. 脚踏实地的, 稳健的, 准没错的

surely.definition: r. definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')
surely.translation:
adv. 的确地, 安全地
[经] 保证, 保证人, 保证金

sureness.definition: n. the quality of being steady and unfailing
sureness.translation: n. 确实, 踏实, 安全

surer.definition:
a having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
s exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
a certain to occur; destined or inevitable
s physically secure or dependable
s reliable in operation or effect
s (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence
s infallible or unfailing
s certain not to fail
s impossible to doubt or dispute
surer.translation: a. 确信的；可靠的；必定的 (sure的变形)

surest.definition:
a having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
s exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
a certain to occur; destined or inevitable
s physically secure or dependable
s reliable in operation or effect
s (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence
s infallible or unfailing
s certain not to fail
s impossible to doubt or dispute
surest.translation:
确信的
确实的
一定的（形容词sure的最高级 ）

sureties.translation: n. 保证人, 担保, 保证( surety的名词复数 )

surety.translation:
n. 保证人, 保证, 担保
[法] 保证人, 担保人, 保证

surety commission.translation: [经] 保证手续费, 保证人佣金

surety-bond.translation: [法] 保证金, 担保, 担保保证金

suretyship.definition:
n. The state of being surety; the obligation of a person
   to answer for the debt, default, or miscarriage of another.
suretyship.translation:
n. 保人的地位, 保人的责任, 保人的资格
[经] 保证人的地位

suretyships.definition:
plural of suretyship
n. The state of being surety; the obligation of a person
   to answer for the debt, default, or miscarriage of another.
suretyships.translation:
(suretyship 的复数) n. 保人的地位, 保人的责任, 保人的资格
[经] 保证人的地位

surexcitation.translation: n. 过度兴奋,过度激动
